name: Converts
overview: Scripture presents converts as individuals who turn away from their former lives and loyally follow the one true God, as exemplified by Ruth's commitment to embrace God's people and deity. The transformation of Nebuchadnezzar and the fear of the Lord by the mariners in Jonah's story further illustrate the power of God to reach diverse peoples and nations. These passages emphasize that conversion involves recognizing God's sovereignty and responding in faith, often amidst challenging circumstances.
